name: Guangdong High Dream Intellectualized Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong High Dream Intellectualized Machinery Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of automatic weighing instruments in China and internationally. The company offers multihead weigher; loss-in-weight feeder; metal detectors, such as conveyor belt type metal detector, X-Ray inspection system, gravity metal detector, conveyor belt metal detector, metal detector for stand-up packet, inclined metal detector, modular belt metal detector, and combined metal detector and check weigher; check weigher; and ACB-Z small 4 head linear weigher, ACZ-C 2 heads linear weigher, and ACZ-A 4 heads linear weigher.
